acceptances_decision_data_check.name: acceptances_decision_data_check
acceptances_decision_data_check.value: ("acceptances"."decision" = 'accepted' and "acceptances"."correctionDueDate" is null) or ("acceptances"."decision" = 'rejected' and "acceptances"."correctionDueDate" is not null)

audit_changes_snapshots_check.name: audit_changes_snapshots_check
audit_changes_snapshots_check.value: ("audit_changes"."action" = 'create' and "audit_changes"."before" is null and "audit_changes"."after" is not null) or ("audit_changes"."action" = 'update' and "audit_changes"."before" is not null and "audit_changes"."after" is not null) or ("audit_changes"."action" = 'delete' and "audit_changes"."before" is not null and "audit_changes"."after" is null)

checklist_items_completion_metadata_chec.name: checklist_items_completion_metadata_check
checklist_items_completion_metadata_chec.value: ("checklist_items"."isCompleted" and "checklist_items"."completedAt" is not null and "checklist_items"."completedByUserId" is not null) or (not "checklist_items"."isCompleted" and "checklist_items"."completedAt" is null and "checklist_items"."completedByUserId" is null)

files_expiration_cleanup_idx.name: files_expiration_cleanup_idx
files_expiration_cleanup_idx.where: "files"."deletedAt" is null and "files"."expiresAt" is not null

files_lifecycle_check.name: files_lifecycle_check
files_lifecycle_check.value: ("files"."status" = 'pending' and "files"."uploadedAt" is null and "files"."deletedAt" is null) or ("files"."status" = 'uploaded' and "files"."uploadedAt" is not null and "files"."deletedAt" is null) or ("files"."status" = 'failed' and "files"."uploadedAt" is null) or ("files"."status" = 'deleted' and "files"."deletedAt" is not null)

material_invoices_paid_details_check.name: material_invoices_paid_details_check
material_invoices_paid_details_check.value: ("material_invoices"."paidAt" is null and "material_invoices"."paidAmountMinor" is null and "material_invoices"."paidDate" is null) or ("material_invoices"."paidAt" is not null and "material_invoices"."paidAmountMinor" is not null and "material_invoices"."paidDate" is not null)

material_invoices_paid_author_check.name: material_invoices_paid_author_check
material_invoices_paid_author_check.value: ("material_invoices"."paidAt" is null and "material_invoices"."paidByUserId" is null) or ("material_invoices"."paidAt" is not null and "material_invoices"."paidByUserId" is not null)

material_invoices_delivered_author_check.name: material_invoices_delivered_author_check
material_invoices_delivered_author_check.value: ("material_invoices"."deliveredAt" is null and "material_invoices"."deliveredByUserId" is null) or ("material_invoices"."deliveredAt" is not null and "material_invoices"."deliveredByUserId" is not null)

material_shortages_resolution_author_che.name: material_shortages_resolution_author_check
material_shortages_resolution_author_che.value: ("material_shortages"."resolvedAt" is null and "material_shortages"."resolvedByUserId" is null and "material_shortages"."resolutionComment" is null) or ("material_shortages"."resolvedAt" is not null and "material_shortages"."resolvedByUserId" is not null)

stages_planned_dates_check.name: stages_planned_dates_check
stages_planned_dates_check.value: "stages"."plannedStartDate" is null or "stages"."plannedEndDate" is null or "stages"."plannedEndDate" >= "stages"."plannedStartDate"
